title: Travel: John Lennon – Hong Kong to Tokyo | 1977
content:
John Lennon and his 19-month old son Sean travelled from Hong Kong to Tokyo in Japan on 11 May 1977.

They had arrived in Hong Kong from New York on 6 May. With them on the trip were their personal assistant Nishi Saimaru and Sean’s nanny Masako.

They stayed in the Presidential Suite of the Hotel Okura, where they were joined by Yoko Ono. The main purpose of the trip was for her family to meet Sean. Lennon remained in Japan until 7 October 1977.
